title: The Local AI Agents Funnel, Debunked
caption: A viral 'local sovereign AI stack' (Omarchy, Qwen 27B, 262K context, agents while you sleep) is a Zoom-call funnel for free open tools. Qwen has no 27B and 262K context needs a multi-GPU rig. Free honest setup tool.
description:
A viral reel sells a 'local sovereign AI stack' (Omarchy + a CLI agent + 'Qwen 27B' + '262K cache' + 'Herdr' for agents 24/7 while you sleep) behind a comment-Ai, join-the-group, book-a-Zoom-call funnel. Every piece is free and open; the specs are wrong (Qwen has no 27B - that's Gemma; 262K context needs tens of GB of VRAM for the KV cache); and local agents with no frontier reviewer ship garbage. Free tool checks your hardware and prints the real setup. Installs nothing, sends nothing.

Code, free: https://github.com/warboy176/local-ai-stack
